messages:
Marta (DevRel): Quick sync: we want a short micro-lab for community devs — tiny refapp + reproducible bench + 30min demo. Need blog, bench blurb, tutorial repo, webinar page, and inbound routing. Who's in?

Owen (Content): I can take the blog + 2 social cards. Need a one-line hero and bench p50/p95 + cost/tokens.

Rita (Growth): For routing: gated sign-up -> tag 'micro-lab-2026'; threshold idea: 50k tokens in 7 days -> AE handoff, else nurture sequence. OK?

Diego (PM): 50k seems fine. We can share hardware (A10G) and model (redwood-tiny-v1). Add a short note on when to pick Dedicated vs Hosted.

Lena (Ops): I'll create the registration page and book Thurs 10am PT. Need speaker list and 30-40min slot.

Marta (DevRel): I'll build the demo repo (FastAPI + Docker) and include rdctl commands to reproduce bench. Example: `rdctl bench --model redwood-tiny-v1 --seq 128 --batch 8 --duration 240`. ETA Mon AM for repo.

Owen (Content): Draft PR link will be posted once benches are uploaded. Hero TL;DR candidate: "Hands-on micro-lab: ship a tiny refapp and see real Dedicated inference numbers."

Rita (Growth): HubSpot mapping I'll draft: lead_source='micro-lab-2026', tags=['micro-lab'], assign_if='tokens_7d>50000', assign_to='AE_inbound'. I'll add UTMs for socials.

link-bot: Calendar event created: "Micro Lab  Thu 10am PT" -> https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3501112223

Diego (PM): Minor ask: include the traffic mix in the blog (70% short prompts, 30% batch requests) so readers can interpret the bench.

Lena (Ops): Shared draft registration page in the event. Waiting on copy and speaker names.

Marta (DevRel): Will schedule a 20min dry-run Wed. Thanks team — assigning owners: Owen content, Marta demo, Rita routing, Diego product ok, Lena ops.

Owen (Content): :thumbsup: will review the repo when available and add final copy.

Rita (Growth): Once reg page live I'll wire the HubSpot form + webhook to #sales-inbound.

Marta (DevRel): Perfect. Closing slack thread for now; will post updates in the PR and calendar event.
